Private Browsing Support

By default, extensions do not run in private/incognito windows unless granted by the browser.

To enable Moment in Private Browsing, open your browser extension settings and toggle "Allow in private windows".

Export Configuration

Download a backup of your collections, rules, boundaries, and settings in clean JSON format. Transient states (active passes, tab timers) are never exported.

Import Configuration

Restore or merge collections from a previously exported Moment JSON backup.

Local-First Architecture

Moment is engineered with absolute respect for your privacy.

  • Zero Telemetry: No analytics, tracking pixels, or network pings are ever executed.
  • Local Storage: All rules, collections, usage logs, and temporary passes remain exclusively on your machine.
  • No Cloud Dependency: Moment works completely offline and will never require an account or login.
  • Mindful Pauses: We do not rely on shame language or unbreakable traps. Moment creates space for conscious choice.
